title: Structure of the unique tetrameric STENOFOLIA homeodomain bound with target promoter DNA.
authors: Pathak, Prabhat Kumar; Zhang, Fei; Peng, Shuxia; Niu, Lifang; Chaturvedi, Juhi; Elliott, Justin; Xiang, Yan; Tadege, Million; Deng, Junpeng
journal: Acta crystallographica. Section D, Structural biology
one_liner_zh: 该文解析了植物WOX家族转录因子STF同源结构域与靶标启动子DNA的晶体复合物结构，揭示四聚体结合模式及TGA基序识别机制，属于TF-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，与本课题高度匹配。
abstract: Homeobox transcription factors are key regulators of morphogenesis and development in both animals and plants. In plants, the WUSCHEL-related homeobox (WOX) family of transcription factors function as central organizers of several developmental programs ranging from embryo patterning to meristematic stem-cell maintenance through transcriptional activation and repression mechanisms. The Medicago truncatula STENOFOLIA (STF) gene is a master regulator of leaf-blade lateral development. Here, the crystal structure of the homeodomain (HD) of STF (STF-HD) in complex with its promoter DNA is reported at 2.1 A resolution. STF-HD binds DNA as a tetramer, enclosing nearly the entire bound DNA surface. The STF-HD tetramer is partially stabilized by docking of the C-terminal tail of one protomer onto a conserved hydrophobic surface on the head of another protomer in a head-to-tail manner. STF-HD specifically binds TGA motifs, although the promoter sequence also contains TAAT motifs. Helix alpha3 not only serves a canonical role as a base reader in the major groove, but also provides DNA binding in the minor groove through basic residues located at its C-terminus. The structural and functional data in planta reported here provide new insights into the DNA-binding mechanisms of plant-specific HDs from the WOX family of transcription factors.
abstract_zh: 同源盒转录因子是动物和植物形态发生和发育的关键调控因子。在植物中，WUSCHEL相关同源盒（WOX）转录因子家族通过转录激活和抑制机制，作为多个发育程序的核心组织者，这些程序涵盖从胚胎模式形成到分生组织干细胞维持。蒺藜苜蓿（Medicago truncatula）的STENOFOLIA（STF）基因是叶片侧向发育的主调控因子。本文报道了STF同源结构域（STF-HD）与其启动子DNA复合物的晶体结构，分辨率为2.1 Å。STF-HD以四聚体形式结合DNA，几乎包被了整个结合的DNA表面。STF-HD四聚体部分通过一个原聚体的C端尾部以头尾相接方式对接至另一个原聚体头部保守疏水表面而得以稳定。STF-HD特异性结合TGA基序，尽管启动子序列也包含TAAT基序。螺旋α3不仅在大沟中发挥碱基读取器的典型作用，还通过其C端碱性残基在小沟中提供DNA结合。本文报道的植物体内结构和功能数据为WOX转录因子家族中植物特异性同源结构域的DNA结合机制提供了新见解。
